jobs.name: 罗马哲学
jobs.cue: Roman forum panorama, whole monumental domes/porticoes/statues, surrounding city and mountains, small everyday figures in the square, existing warm sunlit atmosphere and complete foreground balustrade/steps. Preserve architecture as main subject; no added large philosopher portraits.
jobs.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit / outpainting. ONE 16:9 landscape version of the attached approved artwork. This is ASPECT-RATIO REPAIR ONLY. Preserve its existing style, colors, figures, facial expressions, gestures, all identifiable objects and cultural architecture. Place the COMPLETE original 4:3 scene within the central three quarters of the wide canvas. Keep ALL original top/bottom content, including foreground instruments/books/figures and highest branches/buildings. Extend left/right edges with quiet adjacent terrain/architecture/materials that naturally follow existing perspective, lighting and brushwork. Do not crop, stretch, squeeze, redesign, simplify, substitute portraits or change the original palette. Keep all principal narrative groups and their relative positions/counts. No new characters, unrelated symbolism, labels, diagrams, large lettering, watermark or comparison panel. Small natural inscriptions already on source objects may remain. Maintain coherent anatomy, fine readable hands and distinctive activities; no duplicated limbs. Existing style is good: conservative lateral extension, not wholesale repainting. Preserve the following recognition cues in their existing contexts: Roman forum panorama, whole monumental domes/porticoes/statues, surrounding city and mountains, small everyday figures in the square, existing warm sunlit atmosphere and complete foreground balustrade/steps. Preserve architecture as main subject; no added large philosopher portraits.

jobs.name: 两汉经学
jobs.cue: Academy veranda and its columns, foreground bamboo-slip manuscripts, bamboo/wood book containers and full desks; scholars collating/reading/commenting with distinct gestures, wider academy courtyard, everyday pedestrians, river town, mountain depth. Keep actual classical text study within civic daily life, no giant labels, extra portrait or change of era.

Retain quiet environment-focused composition, no extra figures or invented symbols.
